title: Perfect for my small apartment
body: Bought this water fountain for my two cats. They took to it immediately. Silent pump, easy to clean, and the filter lasts about a month. Great value for the price.

title: Stopped working after 3 weeks
body: The pump died after 3 weeks of light use. Contacted the seller, no response. Do not buy.

title: Good product but MUCH smaller than pictured
body: The fountain itself works fine, but it is way smaller than the photos suggest. My large dog can't use it. If they had accurate dimensions in the listing I would have bought the bigger model instead.

title: It's okay
body: Amazing product!!! Best ever!!! Everyone should buy this!!!
